title: Ezekiel 27
paragraphs: ¹ The word of the LORD came to me: ² "Son of man, raise a lament over Tyre. ³ Say to Tyre, you who stand at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coastlands, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: You said, 'I am perfect in beauty.' ⁴ Your domain stretches across the seas; your builders made your beauty complete. ⁵ They built all your timbers from fir trees from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

⁶ From the oaks of Bashan they made your oars; your deck was of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus, inlaid with ivory. ⁷ Your sail was of fine embroidered linen from Egypt, and it served as your banner; your awning was of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah. ⁸ Men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; your skilled men, Tyre, were your helmsmen. ⁹ Skilled craftsmen from Gebal were on board to caulk your seams. Every ship on the sea and its sailors came to you to trade. ¹⁰ Soldiers from Persia, Lydia, and Libya served in your army; they hung their shields and helmets on your walls, adding to your splendor.

¹¹ Men of Arvad guarded your walls on every side, and warriors from Helech were stationed in your towers. They hung their shields all around your walls; they made your beauty complete. ¹² Tarshish traded with you because of your great wealth, exchanging silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods. ¹³ Greece, Tubal, and Meshech traded with you; they bartered slaves and bronze articles for your merchandise. ¹⁴ Beth Togarmah traded workhorses, war horses, and mules for your goods. ¹⁵ The men of Rhodes traded with you; many coastlands were your customers and brought you ivory tusks and ebony as payment.

¹⁶ Aram traded with you because of your many products; they exchanged emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies for your goods. ¹⁷ Judah and Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith, confections, honey, olive oil, and balm for your merchandise. ¹⁸ Damascus traded with you in your many products because of your great wealth, offering wine from Helbon and wool from Zahar. ¹⁹ Vedan and Javan from Uzal bought your merchandise; they traded wrought iron, cassia, and calamus for your goods. ²⁰ Dedan traded with you in saddlecloths for riding.

²¹ Arabia and all the princes of Kedar traded with you in lambs, rams, and goats. ²² The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; they exchanged the finest spices, precious stones, and gold for your goods. ²³ Haran, Canneh, Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Kilmad traded with you. ²⁴ They traded with you in fine garments, blue fabric, embroidered work, and multicolored rugs with braided cords — all this they traded in your marketplace. ²⁵ The ships of Tarshish were your carriers for your merchandise. So you were filled with cargo and were glorious, floating in the heart of the seas.

²⁶ Your oarsmen have rowed you into deep waters, but the east wind has wrecked you in the heart of the seas. ²⁷ Your wealth, merchandise, and goods, your sailors and helmsmen, your caulkers and merchants, and all your soldiers who are in you, along with all your company on board — all will sink into the heart of the seas on the day of your shipwreck. ²⁸ The shorelands will quake at the sound of your pilots' cries. ²⁹ All who handle the oars will abandon their ships; the sailors and all the helmsmen will stand on the shore. ³⁰ They will weep aloud over you and cry in bitter grief. They will throw dust on their heads and roll themselves in ashes.

³¹ They will shave their heads because of you and put on sackcloth. They will weep over you with deep anguish and bitter mourning. ³² In their wailing they will take up a lament for you, crying out: "Who was ever destroyed like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?" ³³ When your merchandise went out over the seas, you satisfied many nations; with your great wealth and goods you enriched the kings of the earth. ³⁴ Now you are wrecked by the seas, sunk to the depths of the water; your merchandise and all your crew have gone down with you. ³⁵ All who live along the coast are appalled at you; their kings shudder with horror and their faces are twisted with fear.
³⁶ The merchants among the nations hiss at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.
